name: Be More 3D BEM PRO 9500
summary: CE-marked gantry 3D concrete printer that is assembled on the building site and runs on levelling rails (22 m included) to print single-storey houses and walls in line without a crane.

germany.statusNote: EU maker (Valencia, Spain) sells and rents its printers directly on request; the product page says the machines are CE-marked. No price, German reseller or German-language page found.

sellers.name: Be More 3D
sellers.note: Av. dels Tarongers s/n, 46022 Valencia, Spain. Sells and rents its printers ('Venta y Alquiler'); machines built to order, all dimensions customisable.

specs.label: Print volume W × H × L
specs.conditions: 22 m of levelling rails included; rails can be moved on
specs.quote: Volumen de impresión: 9.5m ancho x 3.5m alto x ∞ largo.

specs.label: Width (X axis), customisable
specs.quote: Eje horizontal X: Desde 6.5m hasta 12m de ancho.

specs.label: Height (Z axis)
specs.quote: Eje vertical Z: 3m ó 3.5m de alto.

specs.label: Print speed
specs.quote: Trabaja con un rango de velocidades de 20mm/s hasta los 200mm/s.

specs.label: Material hopper
specs.conditions: usable volume, with pumping system, comb and vibrator
specs.quote: una gran tolva de almacenaje de material de 45l de volumen útil

specs.label: CE marking
specs.conditions: double emergency stop, perimeter safety fence, limit switches
specs.quote: Cuenta con marcado CE, doble seta de emergencia, vallado perimetral de seguridad

specs.label: Print time, 55 m² house
specs.conditions: maker estimate; about 1 h to move between houses
specs.quote: Una vivienda de 55 m2 de puede imprimir en unas 6 horas aproximadamente.

notes: Gantry assembled on site; travels on levelling rails laid on the slab, a screed or well-compacted ground.
Printing can be paused and resumed at the same point for multi-day builds.
